examples.observation: Daihatsu RKO three-wheeler: the prominent single front wheel sits beneath a narrow forward chassis/fork, while the cab and long open flatbed step rearward. Large empty windscreen and door fields are enclosed by paired frame strokes; wheel rings and bounded grille/chassis hatching describe mechanical density. A four-wheel passenger-car donor cannot represent this construction by recolouring. Preserve the central front support, cab/bed proportion and negative spaces; do not copy the caption or make all body interiors hatch. The far-side support and unseen rear require separately declared3D inference.

Toyota Hiace, direct frontal view: a tall near-rectangular body with softened roof corners, one wide empty windscreen, square projecting mirrors, paired rectangular lamps, narrow horizontal grille/bumper strata and two low tire columns. Its read relies on bilateral placement and large protected windshield/face openings, not a sedan roof/bonnet. Retain restrained repeated horizontal grille marks, but do not paste a flat frontal AA onto a van or infer the unseen side/rear proportions as source facts.

Countach, three-quarter view with both scissor doors raised: the low wedge bonnet and compact cabin are interrupted by two tall angled door planes with separate window openings. The near wheel is larger and the far wheel foreshortens; lower body strokes join the arches without filling their voids. Door pose/hinge attachment and overlap are identity-bearing3D state, not optional decorative lines. Preserve the open-state silhouette and panel breaks; reject literal caption/mark copying and a closed-roof coupe substituted for this pose.

TVR Sagaris instrument-panel close-up, not a full exterior car: paired scalloped gauge arcs, sparse numeral/tick/indicator groups and a rectangular lower display sit above bounded lower hatching. Review it rather than skipping it, but do not count it as another exterior model or infer Sagaris body shape from it. It may inform an explicitly scoped cockpit/instrument construction; the label and numerals are functional source content, not generic car-body hatching.
